interpretation: Counts explicit words in each public idea plus its model-supplied mechanism. These are text-pattern measurements, not human-validated semantic labels. Nonmatches mean no matching wording, not proven absence of a feature. Each rule counts at most once per sample.

rules.label: mentions tracking
rules.question: What have you learned from trying to track something that these ideas overlook?

rules.label: mentions reminders or notifications
rules.question: What do you know about when a reminder helps, or gets ignored, in your own situation?

rules.label: mentions recommendations or suggestions
rules.question: What do you know about the people using this that a general recommendation would miss?

rules.label: mentions personalization
rules.question: What specific knowledge from your life would change what gets personalized?

rules.label: mentions chat or conversation
rules.question: What do you know about this task that would change how a conversation should work?

rules.label: mentions answering questions
rules.question: What questions come up in your own experience that these ideas would not know to ask?

rules.label: mentions search or retrieval
rules.question: What do you know about finding the right information here that these search ideas overlook?

rules.label: mentions analysis
rules.question: What context from your own experience would change how these results should be interpreted?

rules.label: mentions summaries
rules.question: What would you need to keep in a summary that someone unfamiliar with this work might leave out?

rules.label: mentions extracting information
rules.question: What do you know about these documents or inputs that would change what gets extracted?

rules.label: mentions classification or tags
rules.question: What distinctions matter in your own work that the usual categories would miss?

rules.label: mentions charts or visualization
rules.question: What decision in your own experience would this display need to help someone make?

rules.label: mentions generating content
rules.question: What would you bring from your own experience that would change what gets generated?

rules.label: mentions automation
rules.question: What part of this work needs your judgment even when the routine steps are automated?

rules.label: mentions quizzes or flashcards
rules.question: What have you noticed about how people learn this that a generated quiz would miss?

rules.label: mentions tasks or to-do lists
rules.question: What do you know about how this work actually gets done that a task list would miss?

rules.label: mentions habits or routines
rules.question: What have you learned about keeping a routine that these ideas would not know?

rules.label: mentions journaling or reflection
rules.question: What personal experience would change how someone reflects with this tool?

rules.label: mentions sentiment or emotions
rules.question: What do you know about expressing feelings in this setting that a general model might miss?

rules.label: mentions feedback
rules.question: What makes feedback useful in your own experience with this problem?
